summary: Tested container configurations: AAP and RHEL subscriptions; RHEL 9.4+ or RHEL 10; x86_64, AArch64, s390x, ppc64le; ansible-core 2.14 (RHEL 9) or 2.16 (RHEL 10) from AppStream installed first (AAP bundles 2.16 for itself); Firefox or Chrome; PostgreSQL 15 managed, or external 15, 16 or 17 with ICU (16/17 need external backup); IPv4/IPv6 single or dual stack.
questions: Which RHEL versions are supported for containerized AAP 2.6?
Which PostgreSQL versions can containerized AAP use?
What ansible-core version must be installed before the containerized installer?

answer_card.title: Containerized AAP 2.6 tested configuration
answer_card.answer_md:
- **Subscriptions:** AAP + RHEL (BaseOS, AppStream)
- **OS:** RHEL 9.4+ or RHEL 10
- **CPU:** x86_64, AArch64, s390x, ppc64le
- **ansible-core:** install from AppStream first (2.14 on RHEL 9, 2.16 on RHEL 10); AAP bundles 2.16 for its own use
- **Database:** managed PostgreSQL 15; external PostgreSQL 15, 16 or 17 with ICU (16/17 need your own backup and restore)
- **IP:** IPv4, IPv6, single or dual stack
